findings.title: LDK320 fixed subcircuits do not converge in .op with an ideal current-sink load
findings.detail: With an ideal 100 mA current sink on OUT, ngspice-44 fails dynamic gmin stepping, true gmin stepping and source stepping, then falls back to its transient operating point and returns V(OUT) = -9.033029192738368 V with the internal soft-start node at None instead of 1.0.  The same circuit with a resistor load, or with a .nodeset on the output node, converges to the correct 3.2967 V. The LDK220 subcircuits converge with either load.
findings.impact: A real load is rarely an ideal current sink, so this does not affect normal use, but a .op with an ideal current source load can silently return a non-physical operating point.  This acceptance suite therefore uses resistor loads everywhere.
